gcp/products/runtime-config: Runtime Configurator: deprecated Google Cloud service for storing dynamic configuration values and coordinating services.
gcp/products/secret-manager: Secret Manager: Google Cloud service for storing, versioning and accessing API keys, passwords and certificates securely.
gcp/products/security: Google Cloud security icon: represents security controls and services protecting cloud resources in general.
gcp/products/security-command-center: Security Command Center: Google Cloud risk dashboard that inventories assets and surfaces vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and threats.
gcp/products/security-health-advisor: Security Health Analytics: Security Command Center detector that scans Google Cloud resources for common misconfigurations.
gcp/products/security-key-enforcement: Security key enforcement: requires users to sign in to Google accounts with hardware security keys for phishing-resistant 2-Step Verification.
gcp/products/service-discovery: Service Directory: Google Cloud registry for publishing, discovering and connecting services across environments.
gcp/products/speech-to-text: Speech-to-Text: Google Cloud API converting audio into text with ML-based speech recognition across many languages.
gcp/products/stackdriver: Stackdriver: former name of Google Cloud's operations suite for monitoring, logging and tracing.
gcp/products/standard-network-tier: Standard Tier: lower-cost Google Cloud network tier routing traffic over the public internet instead of Google's backbone.
gcp/products/stream-suite: Stream Suite icon: represents Google Cloud's streaming analytics services like Pub/Sub and Dataflow used together.
gcp/products/support: Google Cloud Customer Care: technical support plans and case management for Google Cloud customers.
gcp/products/tensor-flow-enterprise: TensorFlow Enterprise: Google Cloud-optimized TensorFlow distribution with long-term support for production ML workloads.
gcp/products/text-to-speech: Text-to-Speech: Google Cloud API that synthesizes natural-sounding speech from text using neural voices.
gcp/products/tools-for-power-shell: Cloud Tools for PowerShell: PowerShell cmdlets for managing Google Cloud resources from Windows environments.
gcp/products/trace: Cloud Trace: Google Cloud distributed tracing system collecting request latency data to find performance bottlenecks.
gcp/products/traffic-director: Traffic Director: Google Cloud's managed control plane for service mesh traffic management using Envoy and proxyless gRPC.
gcp/products/transfer: Storage Transfer Service: moves large amounts of data into Cloud Storage from other clouds, HTTP sources or on-premises.
gcp/products/transfer-appliance: Transfer Appliance: physical high-capacity storage device shipped to you for offline bulk data migration into Google Cloud.
gcp/products/user-preferences: User preferences icon: represents per-user console settings such as language, notifications and display options.
gcp/products/vertex-ai: Vertex AI: Google Cloud machine learning platform covering datasets, training, model registry, endpoints and Gemini generative AI.
gcp/products/video-intelligence-api: Video Intelligence API: Google Cloud API that detects objects, shots, text and explicit content in video.
gcp/products/virtual-private-cloud: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC): Google Cloud's global software-defined network with subnets, routes and firewall rules for your resources.
gcp/products/visual-inspection: Visual Inspection AI: Google Cloud solution that detects manufacturing defects in product images using computer vision.
gcp/products/vmware-engine: Google Cloud VMware Engine: fully managed VMware environment on Google Cloud for migrating and running vSphere workloads.
gcp/products/web-risk: Web Risk API: lets applications check URLs against Google's lists of unsafe, phishing and malware sites.
gcp/products/web-security-scanner: Web Security Scanner: Security Command Center tool that crawls web apps to find vulnerabilities like XSS and mixed content.
gcp/products/workflows: Workflows: Google Cloud serverless orchestration that sequences calls to services and APIs in YAML or JSON-defined steps.
gcp/products/workload-identity-pool: Workload Identity Federation pool: lets external workloads from AWS, Azure or OIDC providers access Google Cloud without service account keys.
